title: Underlying tensor normalization of pro-etale scalar and inverse-image comparison
statement:
Fix a homomorphism $\varphi:A\to B$ of finite commutative rings, and an arbitrary morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$. Use the ordinary uncompleted unbounded small pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the exact identified-coefficient inverse images $L_R=f_R^*$ for $R=A,B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and the canonical constant-ring maps $c_R:f^{-1}R_Y\simeq R_X$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Write $T_Z=(-)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Z}B_Z$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] and let $r_Z$ restrict scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] for $Z=X,Y$. Let $b:r_XL_B\simeq L_Ar_Y$ be the canonical restriction comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], and let $\theta:L_BT_Y\simeq T_XL_A$ be the canonical coefficient/pullback comparison [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Let $\tau_K:L_A(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Y}B_Y)\simeq L_AK\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}B_X$ be the canonical tensor/pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], using $c_B$ on the coefficient factor. Under $r_ZT_ZK=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Z}B_Z$, one has, naturally for every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$,
$$r_X(\theta_K)\circ b_{T_YK}^{-1}=\tau_K.$$
More precisely, for every flat-term K-flat cochain complex $P$ of $A_Y$-module sheaves [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the left-hand comparison at $K=QP$ is represented, through the canonical scalar-derived counits and the exact inverse-image and restriction localization factor maps, by the chain isomorphism
$$t_P:f_A^*r_Y(P\otimes_{A_Y}B_Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_X(f_A^*P\otimes_{A_X}B_X).$$
Here tensor means the sheafified tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and scalar restriction on complexes is termwise. In degree $i$, for an object $V$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and sections $x\in P^i(V)$ and $s\in B_Y(V)$, the map sends the inverse-image unit section of $x\otimes s$ to the tensor of the inverse-image unit section of $x$ and $c_B(f^{-1}s)$ on $X\times_YV$. No boundedness of $P$ or $K$, and no flatness or finite Tor dimension of $B$ over $A$, is required.

source.place: Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product, proof: the ordinary tensor comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives; constant-coefficient scalar-action normalization supplied here

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary normalized balancing isomorphism t. Construct c_t degreewise from the two ordinary scalar-to-tensor identifications and t. Apply naturality of the pullback unit, and cancel the target ordinary tensor isomorphism, to prove the exact section formula.
The universal scalar-counit square for c_t proves the chain-model localization square, giving the second conjunct.

For flat-term K-flat P, the tensor representative square and scalar-counit square have the same ordinary chain map c_t. Pullback preserves flat-term K-flat complexes, so its scalar counit is invertible. Cancel this counit and the exact factors, then cancel the scalar-to-tensor isomorphism at X, to prove equality of the two natural comparisons at QP.

For arbitrary K, choose a cochain representative and a flat-term K-flat resolution P of it. The localized resolution is an isomorphism QP to K. Naturality of both comparison isomorphisms and cancellation of its source-functor image extend the equality from QP to K. The resolution's monoidal flatness witness is converted to site flatness by the site/monoidal tensor-right isomorphism.

theorem proEtaleScalarTensorNormalization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A))
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (proEtaleConstantRing X A)) :
    (∀ K : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A,
      (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).map
          ((scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ Y aY).inv.app K) ≫
        (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f
          (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y B)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X A) (proEtaleConstantRing X B)
          (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ) (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)
          (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f B)
          (proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap_naturality f
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift φ))).symm).inv.app
              ((directImageScalarExtension φ Y).obj K) ≫
        (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app K) ≫
        (scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ X aX).hom.app
          ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).obj K) =
      (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
        (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
        (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) aY aX).hom.app
          (K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (scalarMateCoefficientComplex φ Y)) ≫
        aX.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
          (𝟙 ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).obj K))
          (scalarMateDerivedCoefficientPullback φ f).hom)) ∧
    (∀ P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat.{u + 1, u}
        (R := proEtaleConstantRing Y A) P →
      (∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (P.X i)) →
      ∃ t :
        ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≅
        ((scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((reductionChangeComplex X (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)).obj
            (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)),
        (∀ (i : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt)
          (x : (P.X i).val.obj (Opposite.op V))
          (s : (proEtaleConstantRing Y B).obj.obj (Opposite.op V)),
          (t.hom.f i).val.app (Opposite.op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
            (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction A f).unit.app
              ((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).obj
                ((reductionChange Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj
                  (P.X i)))).val.app (Opposite.op V)
                    (reductionTensorSection Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)
                      (P.X i) (Opposite.op V) s x)) =
          reductionTensorSection X (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)
            ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).obj (P.X i))
            (Opposite.op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
            (((proEtaleRingDirectImageMap f (proEtaleConstantRing Y B)
              (proEtaleConstantRing X B) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f B)).hom.app
                (Opposite.op V)) s)
            (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction A f).unit.app (P.X i)).val.app
              (Opposite.op V) x)) ∧
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).map
          ((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
              (scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ Y P) ≫
            (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
          (proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            (((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map t.hom =
        (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f
          (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y B)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X A) (proEtaleConstantRing X B)
          (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ) (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)
          (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f B)
          (proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap_naturality f
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift φ))).symm).inv.app
              ((directImageScalarExtension φ Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
          (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
              (directImageScalarExtension φ X).map
                ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
              scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ X
                (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
          (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((reductionChangeComplex X (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)).obj
              (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
